sql: SELECT l_returnflag, l_linestatus, sum(l_quantity) AS sum_qty, sum(l_extendedprice) AS sum_base_price, sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sum_disc_price, avg(l_quantity) AS avg_qty, count(*) AS count_order FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate <= DATE '1998-09-02' GROUP BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus ORDER BY l_returnflag, l_linestatus
COPY (SELECT * FROM lineitem WHERE l_quantity > 1) TO '{out}' (FORMAT parquet)
SELECT l_orderkey, l_comment FROM lineitem ORDER BY l_comment DESC, l_orderkey LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) AS groups, sum(s) AS total FROM (SELECT l_orderkey, l_linenumber, sum(l_quantity) AS s FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey, l_linenumber) t
SELECT count(*) AS groups, sum(n) AS total FROM (SELECT l_comment, count(*) AS n FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_comment) t
SELECT count(DISTINCT l_comment) AS n FROM lineitem
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_suppkey, l_comment FROM lineitem) t
SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(length(o_comment)) AS c FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey
SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(a.l_quantity + b.l_quantity) AS q FROM lineitem a JOIN lineitem b ON a.l_orderkey = b.l_orderkey AND a.l_linenumber = b.l_linenumber

SELECT count(*) AS groups, sum(s) AS total FROM (SELECT c_name, sum(l_extendedprice) AS s FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN customer ON o_custkey = c_custkey GROUP BY c_name) t
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT l_orderkey, l_suppkey FROM lineitem EXCEPT SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey FROM orders) t

SELECT c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, sum(l_quantity) AS q FROM customer, orders, lineitem WHERE o_orderkey IN (SELECT l_orderkey FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey HAVING sum(l_quantity) > 300) AND c_custkey = o_custkey AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey GROUP BY c_name, c_custkey, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, o_orderdate LIMIT 100
COPY (SELECT * FROM lineitem ORDER BY l_comment, l_orderkey, l_linenumber) TO '{out}' (FORMAT parquet)
SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(rn) AS s FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l_orderkey ORDER BY l_linenumber) AS rn FROM lineitem) t
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM (SELECT rank() OVER (PARTITION BY l_returnflag ORDER BY l_comment) AS r FROM lineitem) t WHERE r = 1
SELECT max(length(l_comment) + d) AS m FROM (SELECT l_comment, l_extendedprice - avg(l_extendedprice) OVER (PARTITION BY l_returnflag) AS d FROM lineitem) t
SELECT max(length(l_comment) + c) AS m FROM (SELECT l_comment, count(*) OVER () AS c FROM lineitem) t
SELECT l_returnflag, median(l_extendedprice) AS m FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_returnflag ORDER BY l_returnflag
SELECT l_returnflag, length(string_agg(l_comment, ',')) AS len FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_returnflag ORDER BY l_returnflag
